Assessment & Plan:

1. Generalized fatigue with musculoskeletal aches  
   – Assessment: Possible post-infectious fatigue vs Lyme disease vs other systemic pathology (anemia, thyroid, metabolic).  
   – Investigations planned: FBC, renal profile, LFTs, Lyme disease serology.  
   – Treatment: Supportive care pending results.  
   – Follow-up: Telephone review one week after labs.

2. Resolved erythematous calf rash  
   – Assessment: Suspected erythema migrans secondary to possible Lyme disease.  
   – Differential: Nummular eczema, insect bite reaction, fungal infection (less likely given course).  
   – Investigations: Lyme serology included above.  
   – Treatment: Start antibiotics only if serology positive or clinical suspicion remains high.  

3. Asthma (stable)  
   – Assessment: Well-controlled; no recent exacerbations.  
   – Treatment: Continue preventer inhaler; ensure reliever available; encourage adherence.  
   – Follow-up: Routine review with primary care if control changes.
